title: Docs still describe the include!() assembly after the migration: architecture.md, host-architecture.md, rust-type-safety-plan.md
outcome: Found by Fable52 during w-54bc72cb22b2 (mailbox 30a7a691 #55). After the include! migration landed (master ebc30de9), these docs still describe the old include!-assembled build: docs/architecture.md lines about 1592, 1748 and 1762 ("still compiled as one crate-level module through `include!`", "Include-split backend"); docs/features/host-architecture.md lines about 99, 391, 419-420, 1199 and 1871 ("`src/main.rs` builds the backend from 150 `include!()` fragments"); docs/rust-type-safety-plan.md about line 195 ("module privacy cannot…"). architecture.md is plainly stale. host-architecture.md and the type-safety plan argue from the include build, so they need reasoning updates, not word swaps. It's a Markdown-only change, so it lands with the doc link check under the commit rule, and both reviewers still review it.
acceptance: No doc in docs/ describes the current backend as assembled from include!() fragments in src/main.rs or as one flat crate-level module; statements about historical state are marked as historical.
Arguments in docs/features/host-architecture.md and docs/rust-type-safety-plan.md that relied on the include build are updated to the module layout, including what module privacy now allows.
The independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope finding of Medium or higher, and the doc link check passes on the exact landed input.
